question: 设 $a_n = \int_0^1 x^n \sqrt{1-x^2} dx$，$b_n = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^n t dt$，$n=0,1,2,\dots$，计算 $$\sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{b_n}{(2n+1)a_n} x^{2n}$$
raw_question_text: 设 $a_n = \int_0^1 x^n \sqrt{1-x^2} dx$，$b_n = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin^n t dt$，$n=0,1,2,\dots$，计算 $$\sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{b_n}{(2n+1)a_n} x^{2n}$$
